visualCharacteristics.description: Each slide shows a circular winner portrait, name and city, a See all winners pill CTA, and a prize panel (game logo, Winner label, boxed prize amount) over a graphic background. Side chevrons and dots below.

contentPattern.structure: optional first row with a single image cell = block background graphic; then one row per winner: cell 1 = winner photo (image only), cell 2 = name, location, CTA link, cell 3 (optional) = game logo image, label (e.g. Winner) and prize amount (last line)
contentPattern.description: Interactive slider of winner slides with navigation chevrons and dots.

usage: Recent winners section; author the section heading as default content above the block.
reuseGuidance: Use for person-plus-prize spotlights. For plain image banners use carousel-promo.
